subject_line: Shapes App Brings AI Into Group Chats
tldr: Shapes app emerges with $8M funding, integrating AI characters into human group chats.
A new agentic AI test harness helps game developers automate playtesting.
AI models show significant inconsistency in a carb-counting experiment across 27,000 attempts.

top_stories.title: Shapes App Integrates Humans and AI in Group Chats
top_stories.what: Shapes, a new app backed by $8 million in seed funding, allows humans and AI characters to interact within the same group chats, addressing 'AI Psychosis' through social integration.
top_stories.why: This approach presents a novel architectural pattern for AI-human collaboration, offering builders inspiration for creating more socially integrated and context-aware AI applications beyond one-on-one interactions.

important_developments.title: AI Fails to Consistently Count Carbs
important_developments.what: An experiment revealed an AI couldn't consistently count carbs over 27,000 attempts, exposing significant reliability issues in AI models for precise, repetitive tasks that demand accuracy.

builder_tools.title: AI Agent for Game Playtesting
builder_tools.what: A developer built an AI agent to autonomously playtest his game, automating the tedious process of finding bugs and evaluating gameplay, offering a practical use case for agentic AI.
